commands:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=dcd99f07faf9e159a1b6b3f0b76ccff1e9db8ce1
HOST=michal@192.168.0.23
STAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S')
DEST="$HOME/Desktop/PhotoMaps-full-backup-$STAMP"
PART="$DEST.partial"
REMOTE_REPORT=/tmp/photomap-full-backup-046.json
rm -rf "$PART"
cleanup_local() { rm -rf "$PART"; }
trap cleanup_local EXIT INT TERM

echo '=== VERIFY BINDING / REVISION / SERVICE ==='
git fetch origin main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 "$HOST" "cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps && test '\$(git rev-parse HEAD)' = '$EXPECTED' && test '\$(systemctl is-active photomap.service)' = active && test -f backend/data/app.db"

echo '=== REMOTE PREFLIGHT + OFFICIAL FULL BACKUP ==='
REMOTE_OUTPUT=$(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 "$HOST" "EXPECTED='$EXPECTED' REMOTE_REPORT='$REMOTE_REPORT' bash -s" <<'REMOTE_SCRIPT'
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
test "$(systemctl is-active photomap.service)" = active
SOURCE_BYTES=$(du -sb backend/data/app.db backend/storage | awk '{s+=$1} END{print s+0}')
FREE_BYTES=$(df -B1 --output=avail . | tail -n1 | tr -d ' ')
LATEST=$(find backups -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'local-*' 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -n1 || true)
if [ -z "$LATEST" ]; then
  REQUIRED=$((SOURCE_BYTES + 536870912))
  if [ "$FREE_BYTES" -lt "$REQUIRED" ]; then
    echo "insufficient_remote_space free=$FREE_BYTES required=$REQUIRED source=$SOURCE_BYTES" >&2
    exit 70
  fi
fi
echo "source_bytes=$SOURCE_BYTES free_bytes_before=$FREE_BYTES previous_backup=${LATEST:-none}"
./scripts/backup_local_data.sh --apply --json --output-json "$REMOTE_REPORT" >/tmp/photomap-full-backup-046.stdout
cat /tmp/photomap-full-backup-046.stdout
BACKUP_DIR=$(python3 - "$REMOTE_REPORT" <<'PY'
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
r=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
assert r['status'] == 'ok', r
issues=r['diagnostics']['summary']['issues']['by_severity']
assert issues['error'] == 0, issues
print(r['backup_dir'])
PY
)
test -d "$BACKUP_DIR"
test -f "$BACKUP_DIR/backend/data/app.db"
test -d "$BACKUP_DIR/backend/storage"
BACKUP_DIR="$BACKUP_DIR" python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib
import os
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(os.environ['BACKUP_DIR'])
db=root/'backend/data/app.db'
conn=sqlite3.connect(db)
try:
    integrity=conn.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0]
    assert integrity == 'ok', integrity
    version=conn.execute('SELECT version_num FROM alembic_version').fetchone()[0]
    photos=conn.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo').fetchone()[0]
    places=conn.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place').fetchone()[0]
finally:
    conn.close()
h=hashlib.sha256(); count=0; total=0
for path in sorted(p for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()):
    rel=path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
    fh=hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1024*1024), b''):
            fh.update(chunk)
    size=path.stat().st_size
    h.update(rel.encode()); h.update(b'\0'); h.update(str(size).encode()); h.update(b'\0'); h.update(fh.hexdigest().encode()); h.update(b'\0')
    count += 1; total += size
print(f'backup_integrity={integrity}')
print(f'backup_alembic={version}')
print(f'backup_photos={photos} backup_places={places}')
print(f'manifest_sha256={h.hexdigest()}')
print(f'manifest_files={count}')
print(f'manifest_bytes={total}')
PY
echo "backup_dir=$BACKUP_DIR"
echo "service_after_backup=$(systemctl is-active photomap.service)"
curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health >/dev/null
rm -f /tmp/photomap-full-backup-046.stdout "$REMOTE_REPORT"
REMOTE_SCRIPT
)
printf '%s\n' "$REMOTE_OUTPUT"
REMOTE_BACKUP=$(printf '%s\n' "$REMOTE_OUTPUT" | awk -F= '/^backup_dir=/{print $2}' | tail -n1)
REMOTE_MANIFEST=$(printf '%s\n' "$REMOTE_OUTPUT" | awk -F= '/^manifest_sha256=/{print $2}' | tail -n1)
REMOTE_FILES=$(printf '%s\n' "$REMOTE_OUTPUT" | awk -F= '/^manifest_files=/{print $2}' | tail -n1)
REMOTE_BYTES=$(printf '%s\n' "$REMOTE_OUTPUT" | awk -F= '/^manifest_bytes=/{print $2}' | tail -n1)
test -n "$REMOTE_BACKUP"
test -n "$REMOTE_MANIFEST"
test -n "$REMOTE_FILES"
test -n "$REMOTE_BYTES"

echo '=== MAC DISK PREFLIGHT ==='
MAC_FREE_KB=$(df -Pk "$HOME/Desktop" | awk 'NR==2{print $4}')
MAC_FREE_BYTES=$((MAC_FREE_KB * 1024))
MAC_REQUIRED=$((REMOTE_BYTES + 1073741824))
echo "mac_free_bytes=$MAC_FREE_BYTES required=$MAC_REQUIRED"
test "$MAC_FREE_BYTES" -ge "$MAC_REQUIRED"

echo '=== COPY FULL BACKUP TO MAC DESKTOP ==='
mkdir -p "$PART"
command -v rsync >/dev/null
rsync -a --partial -e 'ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10' "$HOST:$REMOTE_BACKUP/" "$PART/"

echo '=== VERIFY MAC COPY ==='
LOCAL_META=$(BACKUP_DIR="$PART" python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib
import os
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(os.environ['BACKUP_DIR'])
db=root/'backend/data/app.db'
assert db.is_file(), db
assert (root/'backend/storage').is_dir()
conn=sqlite3.connect(db)
try:
    integrity=conn.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0]
    assert integrity == 'ok', integrity
    version=conn.execute('SELECT version_num FROM alembic_version').fetchone()[0]
    photos=conn.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo').fetchone()[0]
    places=conn.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place').fetchone()[0]
finally:
    conn.close()
h=hashlib.sha256(); count=0; total=0
for path in sorted(p for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()):
    rel=path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
    fh=hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1024*1024), b''):
            fh.update(chunk)
    size=path.stat().st_size
    h.update(rel.encode()); h.update(b'\0'); h.update(str(size).encode()); h.update(b'\0'); h.update(fh.hexdigest().encode()); h.update(b'\0')
    count += 1; total += size
print(h.hexdigest(), count, total, integrity, version, photos, places)
PY
)
set -- $LOCAL_META
LOCAL_MANIFEST=$1
LOCAL_FILES=$2
LOCAL_BYTES=$3
LOCAL_INTEGRITY=$4
LOCAL_VERSION=$5
LOCAL_PHOTOS=$6
LOCAL_PLACES=$7
test "$LOCAL_MANIFEST" = "$REMOTE_MANIFEST"
test "$LOCAL_FILES" = "$REMOTE_FILES"
test "$LOCAL_BYTES" = "$REMOTE_BYTES"
test "$LOCAL_INTEGRITY" = ok
mv "$PART" "$DEST"
trap - EXIT INT TERM

echo '=== FULL BACKUP VERIFIED ==='
echo "mac_backup_path=$DEST"
echo "remote_backup_path=$REMOTE_BACKUP"
echo "backup_manifest_sha256=$LOCAL_MANIFEST"
echo "backup_files=$LOCAL_FILES"
echo "backup_bytes=$LOCAL_BYTES"
echo "backup_integrity=$LOCAL_INTEGRITY"
echo "backup_alembic=$LOCAL_VERSION"
echo "backup_photos=$LOCAL_PHOTOS backup_places=$LOCAL_PLACES"
echo "production_head=$EXPECTED"
echo "production_service=$(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 "$HOST" 'systemctl is-active photomap.service')"
echo full_backup_to_mac_verified
